kebab_example: aliyun iotcc update-service-attribute --service-id c910061f-0000-44e6-b659-000c --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateServiceAttribute

parameters.help_en: The unique ID that the system generates for the application-based statistics service
parameters.help_zh: 系统为分应用统计服务生成的ID，全网唯一
parameters.name: service_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud connector instance
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the application-based statistics service.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or Chinese character. It can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
分应用统计服务的名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the application-based statistics service.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter or Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
分应用统计服务的描述。

长度为2~256个字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，但不能为`http://`或`https://`
parameters.name: service_description

parameters.help_en:
A client token that ensures the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value for this parameter on the client side. The value must be unique across requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. Each API request has a different RequestId
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Performs a check only. Does not modify the service. Checks include required parameters, request format, and business limits. If the check fails, the system returns the corresponding error. If the check passes, the system returns the error code `DryRunOperation`.

false (default): Performs the operation. After passing the check, the system returns an HTTP 2xx status code and modifies the service
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接修改服务
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID where the application-based statistics service is located.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
分应用统计服务所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
